title: Unusual Clinical Findings of Herpes Esophagitis
brief_summary: Herpes esophagitis presents a clinical diagnostic challenge. The investigators report the first case of herpes esophagitis presenting as vocal fold palsy in an immunocompetent host. The investigators case highlights the importance of performing a detailed laryngoscopic examination in any patient with prolonged husky voice.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient of Herpes esophagitis with vocal palsy presentation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient of Herpes esophagitis without vocal palsy presentation
